description: Assembly source code implementing AES encryption/decryption routines and related cryptographic functions for ARM architectures, generated from BoringSSL's Perl script.

methods.name: aes_hw_set_encrypt_key
methods.description: Sets up the encryption key schedule for AES on ARM architecture.

methods.name: aes_hw_set_decrypt_key
methods.description: Sets up the decryption key schedule for AES on ARM architecture.

methods.name: aes_hw_encrypt
methods.description: Performs AES encryption on data using ARM instructions.

methods.name: aes_hw_decrypt
methods.description: Performs AES decryption on data using ARM instructions.

methods.name: aes_hw_cbc_encrypt
methods.description: Performs AES CBC mode encryption/decryption on data.

methods.name: aes_hw_ctr32_encrypt_blocks
methods.description: Performs AES CTR mode encryption on multiple blocks.
